fronius.title: Fronius inverter
fronius.description: Address of the inverter (or its datamanager) on your network. The Solar API must be enabled in the inverter's web interface (Communication → Solar API).

zendure.title: Zendure SolarFlow
zendure.description: Address of the Zendure device on the local network (zenSDK). On newer devices local access is off by default: switch it on in the Zendure app under “Add HEMS”, then leave the app. Supported: SolarFlow 800, 800 Plus, 800 Pro, 1600 AC+, 2400 AC, 2400 AC+, 2400 Pro.

opendtu.title: Hoymiles via OpenDTU
opendtu.description: Address of the OpenDTU on the local network. S-INV reads every inverter the OpenDTU polls; each becomes its own device. Read access without login must be allowed in OpenDTU (Settings → Security, “Allow read-only access”, on by default).

hoymiles_dtu.title: Hoymiles DTU / HMS-W direct
hoymiles_dtu.description: Address of the Hoymiles DTU (DTU-Pro, DTU-Lite, DTU-WLite) or of an inverter with Wi-Fi (HMS-xxxW) on the local network. S-INV reads every inverter behind it; each becomes its own device. Encrypted DTUs are detected automatically. The DTU keeps uploading to the Hoymiles cloud; polling too often can disturb that, so S-INV polls every 35 seconds.

kostal.title: KOSTAL PLENTICORE (Modbus TCP)
kostal.description: Address of the inverter on the local network. Modbus TCP must be switched on in the inverter's web interface (as installer: Settings → Modbus/SunSpec (TCP) → enable). S-INV only reads and never writes. Port and unit id are 1502 and 71 by default.

solax.title: SolaX Hybrid (Modbus TCP)
solax.description: Address of the SolaX monitoring module (Pocket WiFi+LAN) on the local network. The inverter itself does not speak Modbus TCP, only the module; it needs current firmware. S-INV only reads and never writes. Port and unit id are 502 and 1 by default. Supported per SolaX protocol V1.02: X1/X3-Hybrid G4, X1/X3-IES, X3-IES-P, X3-ULTRA and others.

data_description.host: Address of the Pocket WiFi+LAN, for example 192.168.1.95

sungrow.title: Sungrow Hybrid (Modbus TCP)
sungrow.description: Address of the Sungrow inverter (LAN port) or of the WiNet-S/WiNet-S2 connected by network cable on the local network. Sungrow does not support Modbus TCP over Wi-Fi or through the iHomeManager. S-INV only reads and never writes. Port and unit id are 502 and 1 by default. Supported per Sungrow protocol V1.1.17: SH-RS, SH-RT, SH-T, SH-RL, SH-CX, MG-RL and MG-TL. Grid and house values need a smart meter connected directly to the inverter.

data_description.host: Address of the inverter or WiNet-S, for example 192.168.1.96
data_description.unit_id: 1 by default. With a WiNet-S serving several devices, use the inverter's address from the WiNet-S web interface ("Connected devices").

huawei.title: Huawei SUN2000 (Modbus TCP)
huawei.description: Address of the Huawei SDongle on the local network. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the dongle in the FusionSolar app (Commissioning → Communication configuration → Dongle parameter settings → Modbus TCP: "Enable (unrestricted)"). Without a dongle, the inverter's own Wi-Fi access point works too (port 6607, unit id 0). The dongle allows only a few connections at a time – a second Huawei integration may interfere. S-INV only reads and never writes. Grid values need a Huawei Smart Power Sensor (DTSU666-H), battery values a LUNA2000.

data_description.host: Address of the SDongle, for example 192.168.1.97
data_description.unit_id: 1 on the SDongle, 0 on the Wi-Fi access point

ahoy.title: Hoymiles via AhoyDTU
ahoy.description: Address of the AhoyDTU on the local network. S-INV reads all enabled inverters of the AhoyDTU through its web API; each becomes its own device. Reading needs no password, MQTT is not needed.

solakon.title: Solakon ONE (Modbus TCP)
solakon.description: Address of the Solakon ONE on the local network. Modbus TCP is on by default as soon as the device is connected by LAN or Wi-Fi (LAN takes precedence). S-INV only reads and never writes. Port and unit id are 502 and 1 by default. Grid values need a meter or CT connected to the Solakon ONE.

maxxisun.title: Maxxisun MaxxiCharge (webhook)
maxxisun.description: In the maxxisun app set Cloud service to no and Use local server to yes. Enter this address as the API route: {webhook_url}. The address is on the local network; no external access is required. The CCU sends to only one address, so it cannot push to MaxxiChargeConnect at the same time. CCU firmware .44 to .48.

deye_solarman.title: Deye (Solarman V5)
deye_solarman.description: Address of the Deye data logger on the local network. Solarman V5 uses TCP port 8899. The logger serial printed on the stick is required. S-INV only reads holding registers and never writes. Device type 0 selects the family: string 0x0200, single-phase hybrid 0x0300, microinverter 0x0400, three-phase hybrid 0x0500 or 0x0600.

data_description.logger_serial: The decimal serial printed on the logger, not the inverter serial

deye_modbus.title: Deye (Modbus TCP)
deye_modbus.description: Address of the Deye inverter on the local network. Modbus TCP uses port 502 and unit id 1 by default. S-INV only reads holding registers and never writes. Device type 0 selects the family: string 0x0200, single-phase hybrid 0x0300, microinverter 0x0400, three-phase hybrid 0x0500 or 0x0600.

solplanet.title: Solplanet (Modbus TCP)
solplanet.description: Address of the Solplanet inverter or Ai-logger on the local network. Modbus TCP uses port 502 by default; the Ai-logger also accepts 9999. Unit id 3 is the inverter default, and an Ai-logger answers as unit 239. S-INV only reads input registers and never writes. The Ai-Dongle on port 8484 is not supported.

emsesp.title: EMS-ESP
emsesp.description: Bosch/Buderus via EMS-ESP. Read only, no password or token required.

stiebel.title: Stiebel Eltron (ISG Modbus)
stiebel.description: The ISG Modbus TCP/IP software must be enabled; S-INV only reads. The ISG does not provide electric power; use the bridge or a meter for that.

data_description.install_count: On by default during the BETA, can be switched off at any time. When on, only the installed version number (e.g. “S-INV 3.0.0”) is sent to solarforecastml.com once a day – no device- or user-specific data, no identifier, no measured values. Only how often each version was reported per day is stored. Your IP address is technically visible in transit and kept as an encrypted hash for abuse protection for at most two days. Details: https://www.solarforecastml.com/en/privacy

api_request.name: Api request
api_request.description:
Issue a request to an Anker Solix Api endpoint with optional payload parameters.
REMINDER: The user bears the sole risk for a possible loss of the manufacturer's warranty or any damage caused by use of the integration or this Anker Solix Api request action.

method.name: Method
method.description: Select type of request to be issued (most endpoints require the post method)

endpoint.name: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Select or define the endpoint where the request should be sent to (known endpoints are documented in {url})

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Optional object with parameter value pairs or list depending on endpoint. Typical parameters are `site_id` or `device_sn`, but parameter names can vary. Some request error messages may reveal required parameter names and format.

increase_blocked.message: {entity_id} cannot be increased to {value} because minimum change delay of {delay} seconds is not passed

out_of_range.message: {entity_id} cannot be set to {value} because it is outside of allowed range {min}-{max}

active_testmode.message: {entity_id} cannot be used while configuration is running in testmode

local_mode.message: {entity_id} cannot be used while device is running in local mode

apiusage_deactivated.message: {entity_id} cannot be used for requested action {action_name} while Api usage is deactivated

shared_devices.message: {username} cannot be loaded because it shares devices with active configuration {shared_account}

active_devices.message: {device} cannot be removed because it has registered active entities

device_refresh.message: Devices for {coordinator} cannot be updated within less than {min_dev_refresh} seconds

device_refresh_active.message: Devices for {coordinator} cannot be updated while another update is still running

service_not_supported.message: The entity {entity} does not support the action {service}

service_error.message: The action {service} failed, review log for error details

mqtt_command_failed.message: The MQTT command {command} of {coordinator} for device {device_alias} ({device_sn}) failed

action_blocked.message: The action {service} cannot be executed again while still running or startup in progress (timeout at {timeout})
